title: The Carved Ivory Queen
scene: Between 4:15 and 4:35 PM, the carved ivory queen vanished from Board One. The sunroom's glass wall looks out over the garden.

suspects.name: Sylvie Marchand
suspects.testimony: I reset chess clocks in the sunroom from 4:10 to 4:40 PM, completely alone the whole time.
suspects.alibiProof: The sunroom door chime stayed silent, and Keira's view through the glass confirms Sylvie was alone.

suspects.name: Gordon Pierce
suspects.testimony: I was in the sunroom with Sylvie from 4:10 to 4:40 PM, helping her wind the chess clocks.
suspects.contradiction: Keira saw Sylvie alone in the sunroom, and the ivory queen was hidden in Gordon's coat pocket.

suspects.name: Keira Sullivan
suspects.testimony: I watered ferns facing the glass sunroom wall from 4:10 to 4:40 PM; only Sylvie was inside.
suspects.alibiProof: The park groundskeeper chatted with Keira outside the sunroom from 4:10 to 4:40 PM.

suspects.name: Samir Al-Mansoor
suspects.testimony: I arranged spare wooden pawns right beside Board One from 4:15 to 4:35 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: Two junior players sat with Samir beside Board One from 4:15 to 4:35 PM.
